### What changed and why

Describe what this PR changes and why the change is needed. Include the problem being solved and the approach taken.

### How to test

Describe how to verify the changes work as expected. Include steps, commands, or scenarios.

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

Provide any issue addressed by this change using the format `Resolves #<number>`. Mention other related issues or pull requests with relevant context.

### Compatibility notes

Describe any platform, environment, or integration considerations. State if the change is universal or scoped to specific configurations.

### Breaking change assessment

Does this change any public API signature, return type, or default behavior? Is it safe for patch-level consumers? State explicitly.

### Test coverage

List tests added or modified. If none, state why.

### Contributors

Acknowledge by GitHub handle any contributor whose issue or prior work prompted this change.

### AI tool use

If AI tools played a meaningful role in producing this contribution, describe what you used and how. See [AI-POLICY.md](../AI-POLICY.md) for the project's full position. If AI tools were not involved, leave this section blank or remove it.
